name: HZ_PARTY_HIERARCHY_DENORM
description: Oracle internal use only. This table hz_party_hierarchy_denorm store snapshot information of customer hierarchies. This data is used in UI and REST API allowing user to view hierarchies withe better performance.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Unique party indentifier. Foreign key to the HZ_PARTIES table.

columns.name: TREE_STRUCTURE_CODE
columns.description: Unique Identifier for a tree structure.

columns.name: TREE_CODE
columns.description: User defined Identifier for tree code.

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for the tree version.

columns.name: PARENT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the parent account.

columns.name: ULTIMATE_PARENT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the ultimate parent account.

columns.name: DESCENDENT_COUNT
columns.description: Number of child nodes in the hierarchy for the entity.

columns.name: IMMEDIATE_CHILD_COUNT
columns.description: Number of immediate child nodes in the hierarchy for the entity.

columns.name: LIST_OF_ANCESTOR_IDS
columns.description: List of unique party identifier of parent nodes in the hierarchy for the entity.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.
